method: Per-tooth lingual/inferior rest coordination using conservative convex supporting planes; supports remeasured on every actual upper vertex. Each full lower tooth must be separated from every upper tooth by an actual supporting plane or AABB axis.
rejectedMethod: Vertical-only ordering required over4.45mm for an anterior crown and was rejected before authoring; no increased threshold or vertical-placement sweep.
